name: 新西兰技术移民类别居民签证
nameEn: New Zealand Skilled Migrant Category Resident Visa
summary: 面向拥有新西兰技术工作或工作邀请，并符合积分、技术工作经验或技工与技术人员其中一条路线的人士。
summaryEn: For people with skilled employment or an offer in New Zealand who qualify through the points-based, skilled-work-experience, or trades-and-technician pathway.

age.summary: 主申请人申请居民签证时须年满 55 岁或以下。
age.summaryEn: The principal applicant must be aged 55 or younger when applying for residence.

employment.summary: 通常须有新西兰认可雇主提供的合格技术工作或工作邀请，并达到适用工资要求。
employment.summaryEn: A qualifying skilled job or job offer in New Zealand with an accredited employer and the applicable pay requirement is generally required.

pathway.summary: 须符合积分制、技术工作经验或技工与技术人员三条路线之一；各路线对积分、资格、工资和新西兰经验要求不同。
pathway.summaryEn: One of the points-based, skilled-work-experience, or trades-and-technician pathways must be met; their points, qualification, pay and New Zealand experience rules differ.

english.summary: 主申请人须达到技术居留适用的英语要求。
english.summaryEn: The principal applicant must meet the English requirement for skilled residence.

sources.title: Skilled Migrant Category pathway to residence

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
